title: Ah, the "all you can eat buffet" place.
content: So last night was the place with the all you can eat buffet. Also in this mall was a maritime museum, which was kind of spooky. On the lower level was a 7 day a week indoor flea market. My spouse got his plate of food, but even after I looked at all of the different buffets, I wasn't hungry (that should have told me "dream", but I never know I am dreaming). My spouse went and sat down, and I kept roaming around, playing some odd games that were near the entrance, eventually going into the maritime museum, then down to the flea market. I saw a dealer who had just dozens of paper grocery bags full of collectible ephemera, $7 each. I found one with magazines, collectibles and posters I wanted, and thinking I had to buy them at the buffet cashier, I went back up and as I did, I realized I had dropped the bag somewhere. I went looking for it, even back to the flea market, but couldn't find it. I asked a buffet employee and they asked if I paid for it and I said no I was bringing it to pay. Then the buffet started shutting down, and I went into the hall of the maritime museum to try to find the bathroom. It was distracting because it had a pirate voice that would start telling a story when you walked in. It took a long time to find the bathroom, because the halls were designed like being on an old sailing ship. I think the bathroom was marked "wenches" or something. I went in and locked the door, Suddenly, I heard people outside the door talking about closing up, and the lights went out. I felt my way out and went looking for my spouse. I felt bad we had bought two buffets and I didn't even eat anything. The way back to the car was over a wooden roof, and unless I went a certain way I would have to jump very far down and I can't jump. Finally found a lower board to step down from.
